articles.title: Paradigm shifts vs bubbles: AI chips and bitcoin show powerful trends can still produce severe corrections
articles.snippet: Structural change can create lasting opportunities, but explosive rallies in semiconductors, metals and bitcoin show how quickly strong narratives can become speculative excess.

articles.title: Hyundai completes USDT treasury settlement pilot between US and Mexico
articles.snippet: Hyundai completed a proof-of-concept using Tether's USDT to settle a cross-border treasury transfer between its US and Mexican subsidiaries, highlighting growing enterprise interest in stablecoin-based payments.

articles.title: Donald Trump invokes US senator’s death to push crypto bill
articles.snippet: With the death of Senator Lindsey Graham and another senator hospitalized, Republicans’ current majority in the chamber has been reduced to 51-47, likely requiring more Democratic support to pass crypto market structure.

articles.title: DOJ moves to dismiss charges against alleged $722M BitClub fraudster: Report
articles.snippet: Matthew Goettsche was set to face trial in October for conspiracy to commit wire fraud and selling unregistered securities.

articles.title: How to Make Product Ads With AI for TikTok and YouTube—For (Almost) Free
articles.snippet: One product photo, three AI tools, and about 20 minutes: Here's the full workflow for generating a sales video without a camera, a model, or a studio.
